content.user_title: Generate Polished Videos from Any Brief
content.value_statement: Turning mixed media and creative requirements into consistent video clips requires careful planning. This skill selects a workflow, generates clips, and stitches longer stories.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes supplied images and videos before planning generation.
Routes briefs to single-clip, multi-clip, or product-presenter workflows.
Selects video models based on dialogue, editing, continuity, quality, and cost needs.
Supports text, image, reference video, and audio-guided generation modes.
Plans storyboards and stitches completed clips into one ordered video.
limitations: Requires compatible video generation, analysis, job status, and stitching tools.
Generation costs, durations, resolutions, and media limits depend on the selected provider.
Multi-clip continuity can vary despite reusable references and storyboards.
Standalone music, voiceover, and sound-effect files require a separate audio workflow.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Videos
use_cases.description: Convert a campaign brief and brand references into ordered clips with consistent subjects, products, lighting, and framing.

use_cases.title: Animate Existing Artwork
use_cases.description: Turn a still image into a controlled camera move or subject animation while preserving the supplied opening frame.

use_cases.title: Produce Multi-Clip Stories
use_cases.description: Plan scripts, recurring subjects, storyboards, clip generation, and final stitching for longer narrative videos.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Simple Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a {duration}-second video of {subject} performing {action} in {setting}. Use {aspect_ratio} and include {sound_preference}.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Photo
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate this image for {duration} seconds. Preserve {fixed_elements}, add {motion}, and use a {camera_move} without changing the subject.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Product Story
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a {total_duration}-second product video for {platform}. Show {product_actions}, maintain reference accuracy, and use {tone} across multiple clips.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Audio-Guided Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a {total_duration}-second sequence timed to the supplied audio. Align {visual_beats} with {audio_cues}, preserve {recurring_subjects}, and deliver {resolution}.

output_examples.input: Animate a coffee product photo as a six-second vertical social clip with a slow push-in.
output_examples.output: A six-second vertical clip begins on the supplied photo, adds subtle steam, and moves the camera forward without changing the packaging.

output_examples.input: Create a thirty-second launch story with one presenter, three scenes, and spoken dialogue.
output: An approved concept defines the presenter, setting, script, and three clip actions.
Reusable references and storyboard sheets preserve continuity across the generated clips.
The completed clips are joined in order and returned as one video.

output_examples.input: Make a short fashion clip move in time with an uploaded music track.
output_examples.output: An audio-guided clip aligns planned subject and camera movements with the track while using the supported duration and aspect ratio.

best_practices: Provide the destination, duration, aspect ratio, sound preference, and required actions.
Supply clear reference media for every person, product, place, or style that must remain consistent.
Approve the multi-clip concept before generation because each rendered clip may incur cost.
anti_patterns: Do not combine a start frame with reference images, videos, or audio in one request.
Do not resubmit pending jobs because duplicate requests can create additional billed generations.
Do not invent product details that are absent from supplied reference images.

faq.question: Can this skill generate one clip from text?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports direct text-to-video generation when the requested scene fits within one model-supported clip.

faq.question: Can it animate an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The image can be used as an exact start frame or as a visual reference for a new scene.

faq.question: How does it create longer videos?
faq.answer: It divides the story into clips, creates storyboard sheets, generates each clip, and stitches completed clips in order.

faq.question: Can it preserve the same person or product?
faq.answer: It reuses supplied or generated reference images and consistent descriptions, but exact visual continuity is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Does it support dialogue and audio timing?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan spoken dialogue and guide motion from supplied audio when the selected model supports those inputs.

faq.question: Does it create separate audio files?
faq.answer: No. Clip audio is embedded in the video. Separate voiceover, music, or effects require an audio-generation workflow.
